mapper.update: UPDATE tickets SET ticket_status = #{ticketStatus}, price = #{price}, game_id = #{gameId}, seat = #{seat}, seller_id = #{sellerId}, buyer_id = #{buyerId}, transaction_date = #{transactionDate}, matched_date = #{matchedDate}, image = #{image} WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tickets ( ticket_status, price, game_id, seat, seller_id, buyer_id, transaction_date, matched_date, image ) VALUES ( #{ticketStatus}, #{price}, #{gameId}, #{seat}, #{sellerId}, #{buyerId}, #{transactionDate}, #{matchedDate}, #{image} )
mapper.select: SELECT ticket_id, ticket_status, price, game_id, seat, seller_id, buyer_id, transaction_date, matched_date, image FROM tickets WHERE seller_id = #{userId} or buyer_id = #{userId}

SELECT waitlist_id AS id, user_id AS userId, game_id AS gameId, transaction_id AS transactionId, created_at AS createdAt, waitlist_status AS status FROM waitlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ticket SET buyer_id = #{userId}, matched_date = NOW() WHERE ticket_id = #{ticketId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO other_platform (platform, price, seat, game_datetime, home_team, away_team, stadium, user_email) VALUES (#{platform}, #{price}, #{seat}, #{gameDatetime}, #{homeTeam}, #{awayTeam}, #{stadium} ,#{userEmail})
